subject.title: GitHub OAuth consent still shows personal ClawdHub / steipete branding (reopen of #2524)

question: Should the currently deployed ClawdHub OAuth application be transferred to official OpenClaw ownership, or should production be cut over to a newly created organization-owned application?
rationale: Only an authorized application owner and production credential operator can determine transfer availability, control the client secret, and safely perform the production cutover.

options.title: Transfer and rotate
options.body: Transfer the existing OAuth application to the OpenClaw organization, correct its branding and URLs, rotate its secret, and capture fresh web and CLI consent proof.

options.title: Create and cut over
options.body: Create a new organization-owned OAuth application and perform a planned production credential cutover if the existing application cannot be transferred safely.

recommendation.title: Transfer and rotate
recommendation.body: Transfer the existing OAuth application to the OpenClaw organization, correct its branding and URLs, rotate its secret, and capture fresh web and CLI consent proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The live consent screen identifies this account as the current application owner, so its participation is likely required for either transfer or replacement.
